description: This file defines a template-based Factory class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing mechanisms for creating, managing, and iterating over factory objects that produce and handle base objects identified by unique identifiers. It includes internal classes for factory instances, an iterator for traversing factories, and methods for creating, destroying, and retrieving factory elements.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory instances that produce objects of type BASEOBJECT, identified by IDENTIFIER. It supports creation, destruction, and iteration over factories, as well as retrieving created elements.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the internal map of factories, providing methods to check validity, move to next, reset, and access factory details.

classes.name: FactoryType::IFactory
classes.description: An interface defining methods for factory objects, including getting an element, and retrieving counts of created and queued elements.

classes.name: FactoryType::InternalFactoryType
classes.description: A concrete implementation of IFactory that manages a pool of factory elements, providing access to elements and counts of created and queued items.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by the FactoryType object.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by the given identifier.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory for a specific element type, with an initial queue size, optionally with a custom identifier.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to a factory element of a specific type and identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the base object associated with the given identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse all factories.
